quoted_verbatim_from_the_effective_autho.what_this_IS: A governance limitation of the EVIDENCE CHAIN. A programme that records merges in git but certification verdicts only in conversation has a chain that a third party cannot walk without asking a human. The owner affirmation moves the fact from UNKNOWN to KNOWN-OCCURRED; it does not, and cannot, move VERDICT_ARTIFACT from NOT_MATERIALIZED to MATERIALIZED — OD-6 forbids that motion permanently for this specific instance, because OD-6 itself was ratified in the same act that this correction now also touches.
